UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user account within the Solana Shield AI application. This entity stores core user information without authentication credentials, linking to user-specific data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

Wallet.title: Wallet
Wallet.description: Represents a Solana wallet connected by a user to the Solana Shield AI application, storing its address and associated metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Wallet entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile that owns this wallet. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Wallet)

walletAddress.description: The public address of the Solana wallet.

name.description: An optional, user-defined name or alias for the wallet.

connectionStatus.description: The current connection status of the wallet within the application (e.g., 'connected', 'disconnected', 'error').

lastScannedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this wallet was last subjected to a security scan.

initialSecurityPosture.description: A summary or initial assessment of the wallet's security posture upon first connection.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the wallet record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the wallet record was last updated.

ScanReport.title: ScanReport
ScanReport.description: Stores a summary and key findings from a comprehensive AI-powered security scan performed on a specific wallet.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ScanReport entity.

walletId.description: Reference to the Wallet that was scanned. (Relationship: Wallet 1:N ScanReport)

scannedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when this security scan was completed.

overallStatus.description: The overall security status determined by the scan (e.g., 'Clean', 'Warnings', 'Critical Threats').

summary.description: A brief textual summary of the scan's main findings.

threatCount.description: The total number of threats identified in this scan.

criticalThreatCount.description: The number of critical severity threats identified in this scan.

riskScore.description: A calculated numeric score indicating the overall risk level of the wallet based on the scan.

reportDetailsUrl.description: Optional URL pointing to a more detailed or external report for this scan.

aiModelVersion.description: The version identifier of the AI model used to perform this security scan.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the scan report record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the scan report record was last updated.

Threat.title: Threat
Threat.description: Represents an individual security threat or suspicious activity detected by the AI for a specific wallet or interaction.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Threat entity.

scanReportId.description: Reference to the ScanReport under which this threat was identified. (Relationship: ScanReport 1:N Threat)

walletId.description: Reference to the Wallet to which this threat is related. (Relationship: Wallet 1:N Threat)

type.description: The category of the threat (e.g., 'Phishing Attempt', 'Malicious Transaction', 'Known Malicious Address', 'Vulnerable DApp Connection').

severity.description: The severity level of the detected threat (e.g., 'Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Critical').

description.description: A detailed explanation of the identified threat and its potential impact.

identifiedAddress.description: The blockchain address implicated in the threat, if applicable.

transactionHash.description: The hash of the relevant blockchain transaction associated with the threat, if applicable.

detectionTimestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the threat was first detected.

isResolved.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the threat has been addressed or mitigated by the user.

resolutionDetails.description: Optional details about how the threat was resolved or steps taken.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the threat record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the threat record was last updated.

DappConnectionAudit.title: DappConnectionAudit
DappConnectionAudit.description: Records the audit results for a specific dApp connection or smart contract approval made by a wallet.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DappConnectionAudit entity.

walletId.description: Reference to the Wallet that made the connection or approval. (Relationship: Wallet 1:N DappConnectionAudit)

dappAddress.description: The blockchain address of the dApp or smart contract.

dappName.description: The known name of the dApp, if available.

connectionTimestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the connection was audited or initially established.

auditResult.description: The result of the dApp connection audit (e.g., 'Safe', 'Risky', 'Malicious', 'Untrusted').

vulnerabilitiesFound.description: An array of strings listing specific vulnerabilities or risks identified with this connection.

riskScore.description: A numeric risk score specifically for this dApp connection or approval.

allowanceDetails.description: Details about any token allowances or contract approvals granted to this dApp.

hasBeenRevoked.description: Boolean flag indicating if the connection or associated approvals have been revoked.

revocationId.description: Reference to the RevocationRecord if this dApp connection was revoked. (Relationship: DappConnectionAudit 1:N RevocationRecord)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the dApp connection audit record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the dApp connection audit record was last updated.

RevocationRecord.title: RevocationRecord
RevocationRecord.description: Logs the history of revocation actions taken by a user for malicious or high-risk dApp approvals or token allowances.

id.description: Unique identifier for the RevocationRecord entity.

walletId.description: Reference to the Wallet where the revocation action was performed. (Relationship: Wallet 1:N RevocationRecord)

dappConnectionAuditId.description: Reference to the DappConnectionAudit that led to this revocation. (Relationship: DappConnectionAudit 1:N RevocationRecord)

revocationTimestamp.description: Timestamp indicating when the revocation action was performed.

type.description: The type of asset or approval that was revoked (e.g., 'Token Allowance', 'DApp Approval', 'NFT Approval').

details.description: Specific details about what was revoked (e.g., token address, specific approval permissions).

revokedBy.description: Indicates who initiated the revocation ('User' or 'System').

status.description: The status of the revocation attempt (e.g., 'Success', 'Failed', 'Pending').

transactionHash.description: The blockchain transaction hash of the revocation, if successful.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the revocation record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the revocation record was last updated.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Stores real-time alerts and notifications generated by the Solana Shield AI application for users regarding detected threats or key events.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Notification entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who should receive this notification. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Notification)

walletId.description: Optional reference to the Wallet if the notification is specific to a particular wallet. (Relationship: Wallet 1:N Notification)

type.description: The category of the notification (e.g., 'Threat Detected', 'Scan Complete', 'Revocation Successful', 'Critical Alert').

message.description: The main content or text of the notification.

link.description: Optional URL within the application that the user can follow for more details or action.

isRead.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the user has viewed or acknowledged the notification.

sentAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification was generated and sent.

severity.description: The severity level or importance of the notification (e.g., 'Info', 'Warning', 'Critical').

threatId.description: Optional reference to a specific Threat entity if the notification is related to a detected threat. (Relationship: Threat 1:N Notification)

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the notification record was last updated.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure for Solana Shield AI prioritizes strong authorization independence, clear ownership, and efficient query capabilities, adhering strictly to the core design principles. The structure uses a hierarchical, user-centric model, where all data belonging to a specific user is nested under their unique user ID. This immediately establishes path-based ownership, simplifying top-level security rules.

**Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):** This is achieved by systematically denormalizing the `userId` into every document within subcollections (e.g., `Wallet`, `ScanReport`, `Threat`, `DappConnectionAudit`, `RevocationRecord`, `Notification`). For instance, a `ScanReport` document will explicitly contain the `userId` of the owning user, even though its parent `Wallet` document is already under a user-specific path `/users/{userId}/wallets/{walletId}`. This design choice eliminates the need for expensive and complex `get()` operations in security rules to check parent document ownership. Rules can simply verify `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` directly on the document being accessed, making them atomic, robust, and easy to debug. This also enables atomic creation of related documents in a single batch write without complex security rule dependencies.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** The hierarchical structure combined with denormalized `userId` fields fully supports Queryable Access Patterns. For example:
*   To list all wallets for the authenticated user, a query to `/users/{userId}/wallets` (where `userId` matches `request.auth.uid`) is inherently secure. Firestore rules can ensure `match /users/{userId}/wallets/{walletId}` only allows reads if `userId == request.auth.uid`.
*   To list all `ScanReports` for a specific wallet, the path `/users/{userId}/wallets/{walletId}/scanReports` is used. The denormalized `userId` within each `ScanReport` document, alongside the path-based `userId`, allows rules to confirm `request.auth.uid == resource.data.userId` and `request.auth.uid == userId` (from the path), ensuring secure `list` operations without requiring additional filters in the query. All documents returned by a `list` query will naturally satisfy the security rule conditions because the `userId` is present and validated within each document. This prevents rules from acting as inefficient post-query filters.

**Structural Segregation:** Each collection maintains a homogeneous security posture. For example, all `Wallet` documents under a given user path are private to that user. There are no mixed-access collections, which keeps security rules focused and straightforward. Data clarity and predictability are maintained by using descriptive wildcards (e.g., `{userId}`, `{walletId}`) and enforcing explicit state modeling (e.g., `connectionStatus`, `overallStatus`). This architecture ensures an enterprise-grade, secure, scalable, and highly debuggable Firestore backend for Solana Shield AI.
